mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.created_at asc) AS rn, id, title, year || '년 '|| month ||'월' as targetday, (SELECT LISTAGG(ingredient_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ingredient_name) AS ingredients FROM (SELECT DISTINCT i.ingredient_name FROM curation_detail d JOIN ingredient i ON d.ingredient_id = i.id WHERE d.curation_id = c.id )) as incredient_list FROM curation c ORDER BY c.created_at desc OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 15 ROWS ONLY
